description: This file defines a mock class 'GstCapabilitiesMock' for testing purposes, which implements the 'IGstCapabilities' interface. It includes mock methods for retrieving supported MIME types and checking MIME type support, used within the Rialto server media framework.

classes.name: GstCapabilitiesMock
classes.description: A mock class for IGstCapabilities used in unit testing, providing mocked implementations of its methods.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Mocked method to retrieve supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Mocked method to check if a specific MIME type is supported.
